features.name: ACP→AG-UI Bridge
features.description: Translation layer mapping ACP JSON-RPC notifications (session/update) to AG-UI protocol events (text chunks, reasoning, tool calls). Core of multi-harness support via acpx subprocess sessions.

features.name: Multi-Harness Session Management
features.description: Create, list, stream, and close sessions across harnesses (opencode, claude, codex, gemini, cursor, copilot, langgraph). Subprocess-based via acpx with model selection and working directory per session.

features.name: LangGraph In-Process Agent
features.description: In-process LangGraph StateGraph agent with tool use, streaming AG-UI events directly without acpx/ACP. Supports custom skills loaded from workspace langgraph_agent.json.
features.evidence: backend/langgraph_agent.py + backend/langgraph_session.py, tests in test_langgraph_agent.py and test_langgraph_session.py

features.name: AG-UI FastAPI Server
features.description: FastAPI server exposing AG-UI protocol endpoints: POST /agent/{name} (SSE streaming), GET/POST/DELETE /sessions, model listing. CopilotKit runtimeUrl target with CORS and UTF-8 support.

features.name: Next.js Chat Frontend
features.description: CopilotKit-powered Next.js frontend with multi-session sidebar, chat panel, session creation form, broadcast messaging, theme customization, session status/health indicators, and metrics display.
features.evidence: frontend/app/ components: ChatPanel, Sidebar, SessionForm, BroadcastForm, ThemePanel, SessionListItem

features.name: Agent Workspace Skills
features.description: Per-workspace skill system for LangGraph agent: custom system prompts, tool definitions, and skill metadata loaded from langgraph_agent.json in each workspace directory.

features.name: 100+ LLM Model Support
features.description: Catalog of 100+ models across providers (NagaAI free, OpenCode Zen, Amazon Bedrock, Copilot CLI) with model selection per session and provider-specific config handling.

features.name: Session History Persistence
features.description: Chat message history persistence across page reloads using localStorage (frontend) and in-memory/file state (backend). Thread ID management per session.

features.name: Reconnect & Health Monitoring
features.description: SSE reconnection with timeout handling, session health states (connected/disconnected/reconnecting), and per-session status tracking (idle/thinking/tool_use/responding).

features.name: Tool Call Lifecycle
features.description: End-to-end tool call flow: tool call chunks streamed to frontend, tool execution, result events back to agent. Visible in chat UI with tool_use status indicator.

features.name: Harness Engineering Framework
features.description: Integrate harness-creator skill for scaffolding, validating, and benchmarking harness quality across agent workspaces. Standardize harness patterns for new workspace onboarding.

features.name: Broadcast Multi-Session Messaging
features.description: Send same prompt to multiple active sessions simultaneously from frontend BroadcastForm component.

features.name: Test Coverage Expansion
features.description: Expand backend test suite: integration tests for LangGraph, UTF-8 encoding, reconnect timeout, session lifecycle, tool calls. Target: all critical paths covered.
features.evidence: 11 test files in backend/tests/, some areas may need additional coverage
